name: voracious_greatshark_cannot_counter_an_instant
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, counter target artifact or creature spell.' Seat 1 casts Giant Growth on its Bear and holds priority; in response seat 0 flashes in Voracious Greatshark. An instant is no legal target: the trigger has none and does nothing, and Giant Growth then resolves (the Bear is 5/5). (Both pools are filled before Giant Growth is cast: a mana step passes priority.)
